findings.issue: fetchServices reads res.data.data.services on a response where res.data.data is a bare array (getServices returns { data: Array }), so the services list is always empty and BookingWizard step 3 is unusable.
findings.fix: Change the read to: const list = res.data.data?.services || res.data.data || []. Alternatively wrap the server response in serviceController.getServices to { success: true, data: { services } }.

findings.issue: bookingsAPI.cancelBooking(id) sends no request body. bookingController.cancelBooking requires a non-empty reason field and returns 400 AppError when absent, so every customer cancel attempt fails.
findings.fix: Add a reason parameter: cancelBooking: (id, reason) => api.patch(`/bookings/${id}/cancel`, { reason }). Update MyBookingsPage and BookingDetailPage to collect and pass a reason, or remove the server-side requirement for customer-initiated cancels.
